gloss: high waves; large waves; rough seas

definitions.gloss: high waves; large waves; rough seas
definitions.explanation: Abnormally large ocean waves, typically caused by storms, typhoons, or strong winds. A common hazard mentioned in weather warnings.

examples.japanese: {高波|たかなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please watch out for high waves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{高波|たかなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}される→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧。
examples.english: High waves are expected due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {高波|たかなみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}→遊歩道：23484_yuuhodou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になった。
examples.english: The coastal promenade was closed due to high waves.

notes:
Frequently appears in weather forecasts and disaster warnings, especially during typhoon season. Not to be confused with ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧ (tsunami), which is caused by earthquakes or underwater landslides rather than weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高波|たかなみ}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧: high wave advisory
- {高波|たかなみ}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: high wave warning
- {高波|たかなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さらわれる: to be swept away by high waves
- {高波|たかなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧: high waves surge in
